grammar.blend: Version23100; two complete planar support descriptions, straight spine with two absent bounds, two edge_offset triples, bicubic rational NURBS tensor grid, six scalar lists, exact trailer, four absent outer bounds. First post-grid Boolean retained literally in both observed states.
grammar.spring: Complete earlier cubic rational XYZ plus linear UV/plane grammar, with positive inline allocation references instead of hardcoded0; original wrapper/terminal-enum pair and all raw trailer fields retained.
grammar.VBL: Version23100, exactly6 typed pcurve components; each has flags/vector/scalar, plane or spline support, degree1/5 NUBS UV grid and Boolean/zero scalar tail; then literal9, positive scalar, subtype end and four absent outer bounds. No standalone XYZ tensor grid exists in this framing.

UV grids and XYZ grids retain independent domains; no automatic sign flip, orientation or cache-to-edge parameter mapping is applied.
